c1.note: Palantir has never split since its Sept 30, 2020 direct listing; supported by multiple sources, with a 1.00 split ratio in 10-Q/10-K data.

c4.note: The page shows an empty split table with data through 11/10/2026, consistent with 0 splits.

c6.note: No recorded splits is corroborated by several sources; the Marketstack attribution is not directly seen but the substance holds.

c8.note: The table shows a 1.00 ratio for every quarter, including 2026-06-30.

c9.note: Updated Nov 6, 2026, it says no split has been announced; the Oct 2026 Motley Fool piece says none is imminent.

c11.note: Trendlyne states: Palantir has not split the face value of the share since Jan 1, 2000.

c12.note: Bybit says no split was signaled in earnings calls or SEC filings as of July 2025; the page is dated and AI-generated.

c14.note: IBD headline: Wedbush analyst says split 'Highly Likely'; 161% gain and record high are in the snippet, and it is a year-old speculation.

c15.note: IBD snippet confirms RBC's Jaluria surveyed investors ahead of the Nov 3 earnings; MarketWatch confirms investor interest in a split.

c16.note: MarketWatch headline and subhead confirm the Luria 'would not be surprised' quote dated Oct 31, 2025; speculation only, a year old.

c17.note: Article says it trades under $200 so a split is unlikely, and that companies start considering splits around $1,000; it is dated Nov 2025, so stale background.

c18.note: CIBC release table lists PLTR CDR at $59.00 close (Nov 4, 2025) with a 4-for-1 forward split.

c19.note: Release says the split applies to CDRs outstanding after close on Nov 13, 2025, with split-adjusted trading from Nov 14, 2025.

c20.note: The split was of CIBC's CDRs, not Palantir's Class A shares; the 10-Q share counts and the Oct 2026 Fool article show no split of the common stock.

c21.note: The claim is itself hedged as unverified, and a 4:1 split dated 2025-11-14 for a Canadian CDR listing matches CIBC's release; it is not a split of Nasdaq shares.

c25.note: The author says a split becomes much more likely near $500 per share; this is commentary, not a company plan.

c26.note: The 10-Q cover states 2,306,705,341 Class A shares as of Oct 26, 2026.

c27.note: The 10-Q cover states 101,787,133 Class B shares as of Oct 26, 2026.

c28.note: The 10-Q cover states 1,005,000 Class F shares as of Oct 26, 2026.

c29.note: This is the 10-Q for the period ended Sept 30, 2026; the Nov 2, 2026 filing date is not shown in the passages but is plausible after the earnings release.

c30.note: No split is announced, but a future split is not ruled out; the Fool article notes one becomes likelier at higher prices.

c13.note: I could not check the filings themselves. Trendlyne and the Fool both confirm Palantir has never split, which matches the 'no historical split' part. The boilerplate-provision part is plausible but unchecked.

c23.note: The saved Fool page shows $173.44 (+2.74%) at 1:41 PM ET on 11/11/26, not $173.17 at 1:00 PM. A 173.17 figure appears in a different saved file, so this is probably another snapshot of the live quote. It is a transient price that doesn't bear on split history.

c24.note: The article says Palantir is 'now trading at roughly $200 per share' and that it has yet to conduct a split. That is the context for no split being imminent.

c10.note: Palantir listed directly on the NYSE on Sep 30, 2020. Trendlyne and roic.ai show no splits, and Motley Fool (Oct 2026) says none is scheduled. Coverage of the Nov 2–3, 2026 Q3 results mentions no split. I did not open the Lemon page to confirm its Nov 6, 2026 update date.

c11.note: Trendlyne's corporate actions page, fetched Nov 11, 2026, says: 'Palantir has not split the face value of the share since Jan 1, 2000.'

c14.note: IBD article updated Oct 29, 2025: Wedbush's Dan Ives said 'We believe a split is highly likely.' It also says the stock was up 161% in 2025 and hit a record high (intraday 199.85). This was speculation, not an announcement.

c16.note: MarketWatch, updated Oct 31, 2025: D.A. Davidson's Gil Luria 'would not be surprised' by a split, citing the retail base and the rally. He said he had no specific knowledge of a coming split. The article is framed around Netflix's split.

c18.note: CIBC release of Nov 6, 2025: Palantir CDR (CAD Hedged, Cboe Canada: PLTR) 4-for-1 split. The $59.00 pre-split figure is the closing price on Nov 4, 2025.
